name: Christmas in Color at Water World
address: 8800 N Pecos St, Federal Heights, CO 80260
when_note: Nightly, November 20 to December 30, 7 to 9 PM
paras: Christmas in Color turns the Water World parking lots in Federal Heights into a drive-through light show, with the Visit Denver listing showing nightly runs from November 20 to December 30, 2026, 7 to 9 PM. Families stay in the car while millions of lights flash in time with holiday music on the radio.

One ticket covers one vehicle, and the Classic Pass starts at $34.99 with prices varying by date. The Family Pass at $49.99 adds an LED party pack, and the VIP Pass at $59.99 adds priority entry. The drive takes about 30 minutes through tunnels and themed displays, and ticket exchanges are free.
tip: Book a weeknight for shorter lines and tune the radio before the first tunnel so the music starts with the lights.

name: Christmas in Color at Red Rocks
venue: Red Rocks Amphitheatre, Lower South Lots
when_note: Nightly from November 27, with Visit Denver listing the run through December 30, 7 to 9 PM
paras: Below the famous sandstone amphitheatre in Morrison, the lower south lots become a field of animated bulbs for the holidays. Red Rocks announced the return of the lights from November 27, 2026, while the Visit Denver calendar shows evening hours of 7 to 9 PM through December 30. Drivers use Entrance 1 off West Alameda Parkway.

Admission is by car. Classic tickets begin at $34.99, the Family Pass at $49.99 bundles a keepsake bag with LED sticks and 3D glasses, and an $89 Season Pass lets one vehicle return all season. Checkout includes an optional gift to Children's Hospital Colorado.
tip: Pick the Season Pass if you plan to return, since it covers every visit for one vehicle.

name: Christmas in Color at Centennial
when_note: Nightly from November 27 to January 2, 5 to 10 PM, closed Thanksgiving and Christmas
paras: The Centennial location of Christmas in Color is a drive-through at 13600 Eagle Rock Road in Englewood. A post from the Centennial team says the show opens Friday, November 27, 2026 and runs nightly from 5 to 10 PM through January 2, closed on Thanksgiving and Christmas.

Tickets are sold per vehicle. The Classic Pass starts at $34.99, the Family Pass at $49.99 includes an LED party pack, and a Season Pass costs $89. Expect about 30 minutes of lights set to music, with free ticket exchanges if plans change.
tip: Opening weekend sells out first, so reserve a date in advance and keep the exchange option in mind.
